# Example: Mark Zuckerberg's Resignation Letter

**To the Meta Board of Directors and Community,**

After much reflection and consideration, I am writing to inform you of my decision to step down as CEO of Meta, effective two months from today. This has been one of the most difficult decisions of my life, but I believe it is the right time for both me and the company.

When I founded Facebook in my dorm room almost two decades ago, I never imagined it would grow into what Meta has become today. We've connected billions of people, built incredible products like Instagram, WhatsApp, and our Reality Labs initiatives, and have continuously pushed the boundaries of what technology can achieve in bringing people together.

However, I've come to realize that Meta needs fresh leadership to guide it through its next chapter. The metaverse vision requires someone with renewed energy and a different perspective. I am immensely proud of our transition from a social media company to a metaverse-first organization, but I believe now is the time for new leadership to take these ambitions even further.

I want to thank our employees, who have been extraordinary in their dedication and innovation. To our users worldwide: thank you for trusting us with your connections and communities. To the Board: thank you for your guidance and support through both triumphs and challenges.

I will work closely with the Board over the coming weeks to ensure a smooth transition. While I'm stepping back from daily operations, I remain committed to Meta's success and will continue as a board member and significant shareholder.

**Sincerely,**  
Mark Zuckerberg
